hints.title: Choose an order
hints.body: Sorting by end time makes the interval that finishes earliest available first.

hints.title: Keep compatible intervals
hints.body: Keep an interval whenever its start is at or after the end of the last kept interval.

hints.title: Count removals indirectly
hints.body: Maximize the number of kept intervals, then subtract that count from the total.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort intervals by end time
kept = 0
lastEnd = -infinity
for each [start, end] in sorted intervals:
    if start >= lastEnd:
        kept += 1
        lastEnd = end
return length(intervals) - kept
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
